Some attractions in Ellis County include the Cathedral of the Plains, in the National Register of Historic Places, Historic Fort Hays, RPM Speedway, the Sternberg Museum of Natural History, Ellis County Historical Society, Ellis Railroad Museum and annual events like the Ellis County Fair and Wild West Fest, which takes place in July. The county is located midway between two large fishing lakes, Cedar Bluff Reservoir, known for excellent striped bass and smallmouth bass fishing, to the west, and Lake Wilson, known for its black bass, bluegill and catfish angling, to the east. Ellis county is the "Pheasant Capital of the World," as it is considered one of the top three pheasant harvest states in the country, and also for excellent prairie dog, coyote, quail, waterfowl, prairie chicken, wild turkey, antelope and deer hunting."
